preconditions.condition: The task requires choosing an action that best conserves natural resources used in manufacturing televisions.
preconditions.evidence:
You have been given the following task:

Which of the following best conserves natural resources that are used to make a television? A) repair your broken television, B) buy a television that is on sale, C) throw old televisions in the trash, D) donate a new television to your school

postconditions.condition: Donating a television to a school is the best way to conserve resources.
postconditions.evidence:
Analysis of Previous Result: 

To conserve natural resources used to manufacture televisions, extending the life of an existing TV is the most effective option. Donation directly extends the device’s service life and displaces a new purchase by the recipient. Among the given choices—repair your broken television (A), buy a television that is on sale (B), throw old televisions in the trash (C), and donate a television to your school (D)—donating (D) best conserves resources because it enables reuse: the school would otherwise buy one, so one new unit is avoided. Repairing (A) maintains the current device but may not clearly avoid a near-term replacement, so the net avoided new units is roughly zero. Throwing away (C) is wasteful, and buying on sale (B) still requires new manufacturing.

Final Answer: D) donate a television to your school
